One circle under each sound: red for a vowel sound, black for a consonant, green for sh, th, ch and the sh of -tion
One swoop under each syllable
A cup over a vowel that keeps its short sound
A bar over a vowel that spells its name

A bar under letters that work as one unit, most of them spelling one sound: black for consonant units and for doubled letters, boxed or not, green for sh, th, ch and the ti of -tion, red for vowel units. The letters keep their own colours. Qu is the consonant unit with two sounds: the bar ties the q to the u it always comes with, and a circle under each letter counts the k and the w
A red bar under a vowel and its r, with the vowel red, the r black and one circle
A box around the vowel protector at work: a pair or cluster with a vowel after it, which it stops from reaching back. A pair keeps its bond bar when the box comes; a cluster has none

A dotted ring around a silent letter: the e of have, and a consonant that another form of its word says aloud, the g of sign (signal). Other silent consonants join their unit: the kn of knife. “All letters are ‘silent’, but some are more silent than others” (Carney 1994: 40): the g of sign speaks up in signal
An arc from an e, or a vowel after one consonant, back to the vowel it makes long
A small arc under the letters from e, i or y to the c or g it softens
A half-arc that ends in a red X where a box stops the vault
A dotted line between morphemes

A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 47: th without a buzz, as in thin. Words: thin, thick, bath, math, path, moth, cloth, fifth.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 48: ch spells one sound. Words: much, such, rich, lunch, chip, chin, chop, inch.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 50: wh for /w/, and ph for /f/. Words: when, which, whip, whisk, graph.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 51: ng spells one sound. Words: long, song, sing, king, ring, wing, hang, bring.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 52: nk: the n says the sound of ng before k. Words: think, thank, bank, drink, pink, sink, ink, junk.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 54: a, a consonant, then e: the a says its name. Words: make, made, take, came, game, name, cake, gate.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 55: i, a consonant, then e: the i says its name. Words: like, time, five, bike, ride, kite, mine, smile.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 56: o, a consonant, then e: the o says its name. Words: home, hope, note, joke, bone, stone, rope, hole.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 57: e, a consonant, then e: the e says its name. Few words use it. Words: eve, here, theme.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 58: u, a consonant, then e: the u says its name, or /oo/. Words: cute, mule, tube, rule, flute, cube, use, dune.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 63: -es after s, x, sh and ch. Words: boxes, dishes, wishes, foxes, buses, benches, glasses, lunches.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 64: -ed, said three ways and spelled one. Words: jumped, asked, fished, yelled, filled, ended, landed, rested.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 65: -ing added to a word. Words: jumping, fishing, helping, asking, ending, sending, resting, kicking.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 66: Open and closed: a vowel at the end says its name, a consonant after it closes it. Words: he, me, we, she, no, go, so, hi.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 67: Two closed syllables, and compound words. Words: sunset, laptop, napkin, basket, picnic, magnet, bathtub, backpack.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 68: An open syllable, then a closed one. Words: robot, pupil, even, hotel, open, human, bonus, basic.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 60: c before e says /s/, as in face and dance. Words: face, race, nice, rice, ice, place, dance, fence.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 61: g before e says /j/, as in age and hinge. Words: age, page, cage, stage, huge, hinge, plunge, fringe.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 62: A final e that sends no vault: have, give, come. Words: have, give, live, love, come, some, done, none.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 69: tch after a short vowel. Words: catch, match, patch, pitch, itch, ditch, fetch, sketch.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 70: dge after a short vowel. Words: edge, badge, bridge, fudge, ridge, judge, hedge, wedge.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 72: i and o say their names before ld, nd and st. Words: find, kind, mind, wild, child, old, cold, most.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 73: y at the end says the name of i. Words: my, by, why, try, fly, dry, sky, cry.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 74: y at the end of a longer word says the name of e. Words: candy, lucky, empty, sandy, handy, dusty, rusty, silly.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 75: A consonant and le make the last syllable. Words: candle, handle, simple, puzzle, tickle, bubble, apple, little.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 77: ar: the vowel and its r as one unit. Words: car, star, park, dark, farm, arm, yard, sharp.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 78: or and ore. Words: for, short, fork, born, storm, more, store, score.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 80: er. Words: her, fern, herd, term, sister, winter, under, river.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 81: ir and ur: the same sound as er. Words: bird, girl, first, shirt, dirt, turn, hurt, burn.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 82: or after w says the sound of her. Words: work, word, worm, world, worst, worth.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 84: ai inside a word and ay at the end. Words: rain, train, paint, wait, tail, day, play, stay.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 85: ee, ea and ey for the name of e. Words: see, tree, feet, green, eat, sea, read, key.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 86: oa, ow and oe for the name of o. Words: boat, road, coat, goat, snow, grow, show, toe.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 87: ie and igh for the name of i. Words: pie, tie, high, night, light, right, bright, fight.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 89: oo and u for the vowel of book and put. Words: book, look, good, foot, wood, cook, put, push.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 90: oo for the vowel of moon. Words: moon, food, room, zoo, soon, pool, tooth, spoon.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 91: ew, ui and ue for the vowel of moon. Words: new, grew, blew, few, blue, true, glue, fruit.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 93: au, aw and augh for the vowel of saw. Words: saw, draw, straw, paw, crawl, haul, launch, caught.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 94: ea for short e (head), and a after w for short o (want). Words: head, bread, ready, heavy, breath, want, wash, watch.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 95: oi inside a word and oy at the end. Words: oil, coin, boil, join, point, boy, toy, joy.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 96: ou and ow for the vowel of out. Words: out, loud, cloud, round, mouth, cow, now, down.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 98: kn, wr and mb: a silent letter in the unit. Words: knee, knock, knot, write, wrap, wrong, lamb, thumb.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 99: -s and -es on words that name and words that do. Words: toys, plays, runs, jumps, foxes, wishes, glasses, fixes.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 100: -er and -est to compare. Words: taller, tallest, faster, fastest, longer, longest, smaller, smallest.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 101: -ly: how something is done. Words: sadly, softly, quickly, slowly, kindly, badly, loudly, neatly.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 102: -less and -ful. Words: helpful, useful, thankful, hopeful, endless, homeless, helpless, painless.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 103: un- at the front. Words: undo, unlock, unpack, untie, unfold, unzip, unkind, unfair.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 104: pre- and re- at the front. Words: redo, reread, refill, replay, rewind, preheat, preschool, pretest.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 105: dis- at the front. Words: dislike, disagree, disobey, dishonest, distrust, disown, discount, dismiss.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 107: A short word doubles its last consonant before -ing and -ed. Words: running, hopping, sitting, swimming, stopped, hugged, planned, clapped.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 108: Doubling before -er and -est. Words: bigger, biggest, hotter, hottest, sadder, flatter, thinnest, wettest.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 109: The e drops before a suffix that starts with a vowel. Words: making, baking, hoping, riding, smiling, liked, hoped, used.
A spelling list lined up with UFLI Foundations lesson 110: y turns to i before a suffix. Words: tried, cried, flies, babies, happier, funniest, carried, puppies.
